subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓ Is the correct sprite selected in the code blocks?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Which sprite should be moving? ❓What should be changed to make that sprite move?


Solution: The Sam sprite should be selected in the [move sprite with buttons] block instead of the house sprite.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, the wrong sprite moves!


Fix the bug in the code so Sam is able to move around the screen.

subgroups.introduction:
Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!


Fix the bugs in the code to help Sam get home!

validationItems.text: Sprite name changed to Sam in moveSprite block
validationItems.failureText: Check that the correct sprite name has been selected in the [move sprite with buttons] block.

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓ Did you try dragging the [move sprite with buttons]  block to a different place in the code?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Which code block always needs to come first when programming a sprite? 

❓What happens if you change the order of the code blocks for the Sam sprite?


Solution: The sprite needs to be set before it can be moved with the arrow buttons. Any block that refers to the sprite needs to come after its [set sprite to] block.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, neither sprite moves when the direction buttons are pressed.


Fix the bug in the code so that Sam moves when you press the direction buttons.

subgroups.introduction:
Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!


Fix the bugs in the code to help Sam get home!

validationItems.text: Sam sprite set to stay in screen
validationItems.failureText: Check that the toggle is in the right position  in the [set sprite stay in screen] block.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 3 of White Belt! In this level, you’ll learn about events, which are actions that trigger code in your project to run. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 3:

badges.title: An Event to Remember
badges.description: Use events to control actions in a project.

badges.title: Taking Control
badges.description: Use the direction buttons to move a sprite.

badges.title: Think Inside the Box
badges.description: Set a sprite to stay inside the screen.

badges.title: Setting the Scene
badges.description: Add a background image to a project.

badges.title: Layer Cake
badges.description: Use sequence to control which sprite is in front of another.
